say:1:1330281001:1.text: We're holding a small memorial, just a few of us. It's quite spontaneous, really.
say:1:1330281001:1.source_cn: 祭奠都是镇民们自发的，并没有人组织。
say:1:1330281001:1.male: We're holding a small memorial, just a few of us. It's quite spontaneous, really.
say:1:1330281001:1.female: We're holding a small memorial, just a few of us. It's quite spontaneous, really.

say:2:1330281002:1.text: We'll cast floral wreaths into the river and hope the water can carry our love to the princess...
say:2:1330281002:1.source_cn: 大家会将花环丢在河流中，相信河水会将我们的缅怀传递给亚...
